data.question_intent: Inquire about US cards delinquency patterns and CIB revenue sustainability post-COVID
data.question_quote: Two questions, one is on US [cards delinquency] patterns. I think on the results call, you said a lot this is Gap portfolio seasoning, I think the latest Dry Rock data shows it ticking up further. So, is that just further seasoning from the Gap portfolio?
data.answer_quote: On US cards, there's really two or three things going on there. There's obviously, the balances are higher, and that's in some part, driving the charge. But also, there is a normalisation of delinquency levels, I would say, both for Gap and for the existing book.
data.reason: The answer directly addresses both questions, providing a detailed explanation of the US cards delinquency patterns and the CIB revenue sustainability, with high evidence level including numeric evidence and aligned narrative.
